name: Bhabhua Devi Temple
town_description: Bhabhua is the headquarters town of Kaimur district in southwestern Bihar, near the Uttar Pradesh border, a market town serving the surrounding Kaimur hill villages. The district's best-known religious site is the ancient Maa Mundeshwari Devi Temple at Ramgarh in the Kaimur hills, about 22 km from Bhabhua.
